授業概要
This course is designed to guide the doctoral students in writing their dissertations. It is organized to help students cultivate the research question， generate the method for approaching the question， and carry out the research by providing the opportunities for discussing and examining their research with fellow guraduate students and the professor.

全体の教育目標
This course aims to help the doctoral student develop the ability to examine the purpose for addressing the research theme， to cultivate the research question， and to generate the proper method for approaching the question.
個別の教育目標
In this course， doctoral students are expected to develop the ability to examine the purpose for addressing their research themes， to cultivate the research questions， and to generate the proper method for approaching the question.
